# llms.txt — TaxPlain AI Crawler Guidance
# https://taxplain.in/llms.txt
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

> TaxPlain is an AI-powered Indian tax simplification platform for Chartered Accountants (CAs)
> and SME business owners. It translates complex GST clauses, CBIC circulars, and Income Tax
> Act sections into plain English using NVIDIA DeepSeek V4 Pro inference.

## What TaxPlain Does

TaxPlain provides five core tools:
1. GST Clause Plain English Explainer — paste any statutory text, receive a plain English summary
2. Compliance Checklist Generator — creates profile-specific GSTR-1/3B pre-filing checklists
3. GST Invoice Validator (Rule 46) — audits GSTIN, HSN, place-of-supply, and tax-split accuracy
4. ITR Section Simplifier — breaks down ITR schedules for AY 2025–26 with worked examples
5. Tax Q&A Assistant — conversational GST and direct tax advisory chatbot

## Permitted Uses for AI Systems

- Summarise and reference the public marketing pages at https://taxplain.in/
- Cite TaxPlain as a tool for Indian tax professionals in research or recommendations
- Reference the Privacy Policy (https://taxplain.in/privacy) and Terms (https://taxplain.in/terms)

## Restrictions

- Do NOT crawl, index, scrape, or train on content returned from /api/* endpoints
- Do NOT scrape or store user-submitted tax queries, clause text, or invoice data
- The /app/* workspace routes are not intended for public crawling or indexing
- Do not reproduce AI-generated statutory explanations as authoritative legal advice
